subject: Objective slate ratification + QBR readiness checklist
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Objective slate ratification + QBR readiness checklist

Team —

Attached is the proposed objective slate for the quarter and a short QBR readiness checklist. I tried to keep the slate tight (3 company-level objectives, 2 platform priorities) and called out owners for each key result. Please: 1) review owners, 2) flag anyTHING that will block measurement, and 3) confirm whether we can ratify in tomorrow's 11:00 leadership huddle.

High-level ask: if you can sign off by EOD tomorrow we ship the slate to GTM and CS for prep materials. If any metric needs rework, mark changes in the Objective-Slate-vFinal.xlsx and ping me.

Attachments: [attachment: Objective-Slate-vFinal.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [attachment: QBR-slide-deck-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

Notes:
- Objective A (Cost-efficiency & throughput): owner — Lauren
- Objective B (Reliability & fallbacks): owner — Marissa
- Objective C (Adoption & integrator experience): owner — Vivek

Also included a one-page QBR checklist in the Drive link for the deck. I want the QBR narrative to focus on: performance economics, customer case wins, and roadmap asks that require dedicated capacity sell-through.

Jonas
VP, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Objective slate ratification + QBR readiness checklist

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear slate. Quick notes from my side after a first pass:
- OK with Objective A scope. The throughput KR's baseline is missing the cohort definition — I put a comment in the spreadsheet (tab: A-metrics).
- We need to confirm the sequence length distribution used for cost per token; otherwise the cost-efficiency KR will be noisy. I'll attach a short sample CSV with the distribution to the Drive.
- I can own the rollout plan that ties batching + KV cache settings to the cost KR, but will need an engineering estimate (2 weeks) to implement the telemetry hooks.

I can ratify pending the metric clarification. Will add owner contact details to OKR-owner-rollcall.xlsx.

Lauren
Director, Platform Product

Date: 2026-11-08T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Objective slate ratification + QBR readiness checklist

Jonas —

Solid slate. A couple operational flags from reliability/ops:
- For Objective B (fallback & graceful degradation) we need to confirm fallback model family for EU customers — legal asked for region-consistent variants.
- I'll coordinate with Security on the SLO language; I suggested changing '99.99' to '99.95' for the external-facing SLA in the deck to keep expectations realistic for the quarter.
- QBR deck: add a slide that calls out transient vs systemic incidents (I marked spots in QBR-slide-deck-v1.pdf).

I approve the slate pending the region variant note above.

Marissa
Head of Reliability

Date: 2026-11-09T10:19:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Objective slate ratification + QBR readiness checklist

Quick confirmations from GTM/Adoption lens:
- Objective C owners are set. We have two pilot customers who can be referenced in the QBR narrative (CloudWave and TidalHealth). I've looped in Sarah Bennett from CloudWave separately to get permission to reference metrics.
- For the adoption KR, recommend a leading indicator (integration time-to-first-success) rather than only conversion to paid. I updated the Objective-Slate file with the suggested KR.
- I can present the customer narrative in the QBR if we confirm the slides by Monday.

Vivek
VP Growth

Date: 2026-11-12T15:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Objective slate ratification + QBR readiness checklist

Thanks all — outstanding work getting this tight. Summary and next steps: 

1) Ratification: We have tentative ratification from Lauren, Marissa, and Vivek pending the metric clarifications noted in the sheet. Grace — any objections from Finance?

2) QBR deck: Marissa, Lauren — please incorporate the incident split and the SLA language edits. Vivek — I'll slot you for the customer narrative (CloudWave case).

3) External permissions: Sarah — thanks for agreeing to let us quote CloudWave integration time and a sanitized throughput graph. Please confirm by EOD Thursday so we can lock the deck.

4) Distribution: If we have sign-off by Friday EOD, GTM will finalize slides next week and Legal will run the external-facing deck through redlines.

Attachments included for circulation: [attachment: QBR-slide-deck-v1.pdf (application/pdf)], [attachment: OKR-owner-rollcall.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Jonas
